scope: Local Release verification of root execution budget persistence through AgentRunJournal

contracts.runner: Invoked the exact CMake-registered native executables and Node peer harnesses because ctest was unavailable on PATH.

verified_paths: RootExecutionBudget admits runs and reserves/completes model attempts through AgentRunJournal.
Dynamic-plan admission, continuation and human-pause suspension use the journal boundary.
AgentRunner, dynamic-plan engine/repository, context engine, GraphRunner and A2A agent registry contracts pass with the SQLite-backed production adapter.
limitations: AgentRunner still executes in-process and AgentService still owns its thread pool.
Workspace, MCP, A2A, approval and other effect services are not yet transported through a worker host.
This is a focused contract set, not a full Release suite or packaged CLI/web/VS Code acceptance run.
